answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The jetty lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the grove is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vault of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
